meta.name: add-linear
meta.description: Add Linear channel integration via Chat SDK. Issue comment threads as conversations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 Linear 工单评论转为聊天会话
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果团队用 Linear 管理任务并希望直接在聊天中跟进评论。
copy.tagline_en: Turn Linear issue comments into chat conversations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team uses Linear for task management and wants to follow up comments in chat.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能通过 Chat SDK 接入 Linear 频道，自动参与工单评论线程。每条评论都会触发 Claude 回复，无需 @ 提及。
howto.when: 当用户在 Linear 工单下发表评论时触发。

say.text: 帮我回复 Linear 工单 ENG-123 的最新评论。
say.note: Claude 会读取该工单的评论线程并回复。

say.text: 总结今天 Engineering 团队工单的评论动态。
say.note: Claude 会汇总该团队所有工单的评论。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can integrate with Linear via Chat SDK, automatically participating in issue comment threads. Every comment on a Linear issue triggers Claude without needing @-mention.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a user comments on a Linear issue.

say_en.text: Reply to the latest comment on Linear issue ENG-123.
say_en.note: Claude reads the comment thread and responds.

say_en.text: Summarize today's comment activity for the Engineering team.
say_en.note: Claude aggregates comments across all issues in that team.
